clusters.title: UI/UX Quality Improvements and Bug Fixes
clusters.summary: Users are requesting various bug fixes and quality improvements across the application's user interface, including fixing message duplication, display issues with the think tool and repository picker, and message handling during status transitions. Additionally, users want UX enhancements like reducing comment clutter in integrations and new observability features such as per-conversation diagnostics and a scheduled automations management page.
clusters.representative_need: Add a UI page to view and manage scheduled automations with details, run history, and enable/disable/delete controls
sample_titles: Add a UI page to view and manage scheduled automations with details, run history, and enable/disable/delete controls
Add per-conversation diagnostics and observability view for Cloud users
Align Docker frontend builder Node version with package.json engine requirements

clusters.title: Security Guardrails for Agent Actions and Dependencies
clusters.summary: Users want built-in security guardrails to control AI agent behavior and protect against threats. This includes policy-based controls using OPA (Open Policy Agent) to govern what actions agents can execute, as well as supply chain protections like minimum dependency age checks to prevent attacks from newly published malicious packages.
clusters.representative_need: Add OPA-based policy guard for agent action execution
sample_titles: Add OPA-based policy guard for agent action execution
Add minimum dependency age guardrails for Python and npm packages to prevent supply-chain attacks from newly published malicious packages
